description: This file defines a custom exception class 'SecurityNotAllowedPropertyError' used in Twig's sandbox security context. It is thrown when an unauthorized class property is accessed in a Twig template.

classes.name: SecurityNotAllowedPropertyError
classes.description: An exception class indicating an attempt to access a not allowed property on a class within Twig's sandbox security system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the error with a message, class name, and property name.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the name of the class where the security violation occurred.

methods.name: getPropertyName
methods.description: Returns the name of the property that was not allowed.
